completed.end: Hannah agrees to ask about the shrapnel and admires Alden’s scar; he feels heard. The cause of his parents’ deaths is not yet explained.
Hannah explains the bubble and the pursuit to the empty building. Alden learns that even his rescuer does not fully understand her powers.
Hannah admits counting the wrong floor. Alden cries and shouts for everyone to leave; Hannah goes while Amanda approaches, the opposite of what he wanted.
Alden finishes his System homework but cannot sleep in the noisy apartment.
Alden tests the response time; Connie reaches and comforts him in eight seconds. The ninety-second question remains unresolved.
